title: sorbus aucuparia f. xanthocarpa
intro: Sorbus aucuparia f. xanthocarpa, commonly known as the Mountain Ash, is a variant of the Mountain Ash tree, characterized by its yellow fruit. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to support immune function and act as an antioxidant, helping to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus aucuparia f. xanthocarpa include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
